content: <thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 182.0731649. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is 182.0731649 – 1.007276 = 181.065889 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₉H₁₁NO₃ (exact mass = 181.0739 Da, within a few ppm). Expressed in the required format (C x H y O z X), the molecular formula is C9H11O3N.
